render.energy_verbatim: 中高（入场是连续小爆发，展开段收成一次平滑的整体动作）
render.energy_rationale: 入场是连续小爆发，展开段收成一次平滑的整体动作

intent_zh: 一摞卡先聚成一个物体，再摊开成一组物体——顺序很关键：先给"整体"再给"个体"。 观众第一眼记住的是有分量的一摞（数量感），第二眼才看清每张
use_zh: 需要交代"我们有一组东西"的产品段落；卡片墙/模板库/方案列表的建立镜头，也能当 logo 前的一拍蓄势
summary_zh: 8 张卡从屏幕下方逐张 spring 弹入叠成一摞，全员落位后整摞一次性展成 3D 扇面——每张按序号偏转 8°、横移 34px、向后退一层

cast.note: A shot we own. Everything below is our decision; the recipe supplied only the timing and the 8°/34px/layer geometry.

actors.art: eight ledger line-item cards, cream on ink, each showing one transaction row
actors.state_out: fanned in a 3D spread, facing camera-left, reading order preserved

actors.art: tabular figures, 2.4rem, ink on the same cream as the cards
actors.state_out: settled under the fan, aligned to the left edge of the stack

beats.heading: entrance
beats.raw: Cards 1-8 spring in from below, 33ms apart, each overshooting slightly so the stack has weight.

beats.heading: settle
beats.raw: Last card lands at 0.551 of normalised time; the stack holds for a beat so the eye can count it.

beats.heading: fan-out
beats.raw: One shared progress value drives all eight: each card rotates 8° by ordinal, translates 34px, and steps back one layer.

parameters.feel: 8 张是扇面 56° 总张角的舒适上限；>10 张要把每张角度降到 5–6°，否则两端卡飞出画框
小于 1 帧会糊成一条；大于 50ms 队列感消失，变成逐张弹
过冲 6–9% 是"有分量"的区间；超过 12% 读作弹球
56° 之内文字仍可读；超过 70° 边缘两张的透视变形开始吃掉可读性
34px 让相邻卡露出约 60% 宽度，刚好读出"下一张还有内容"

parameters.typical: 每张后退一层，z 步长 12px
parameters.feel: 层深过小扇面读作平面旋转；过大会让最后一张失焦
28 帧 ≈ 0.93s，足够数完 8 张又不至于拖
跨度控制在 112° 以内才不会读作彩虹渐变，破坏"这是一组"的印象

pitfalls.text: 两段时间窗刚好首尾相接：末张入场结束于 `0.02+7*0.033+0.3 = 0.551`，展开始于 0.55。
入场用 per-item spring、展开用一条共享进度；两者写成同一条会把扇面读作乱抖。
扇面展开期间不要加 glow 或阴影：层次已经由层深表达，再加辉光会读作廉价。
卡数 >10 时必须同时降角度到 5–6°，否则两端飞出画框。
文字在扇面里必须跟随每张卡的透视一起变换，不能贴在屏幕上不动。

copy.note: Filled by hand. The recipe supplied timing and geometry; the words, the cast and the colour choices are ours. This is the bar the generated briefs are measured against.

slots.hint: One line. If a demo uses 2 title words, keep 2 words.
slots.rationale: 'Every line, one ledger' states the product's promise and sets the cast: eight line items. 24 characters, inside the 40 limit, and it does not claim anything about accuracy we cannot show on screen.

slots.text: Ledger for teams who hate spreadsheets
slots.rationale: Omitted in the 15s cut. Kept here because the 30s cut needs the category, and 'teams who hate spreadsheets' is a positioning claim we can defend, unlike 'effortless'.
Two words. 'Start free' is the only CTA we use anywhere, because it is the only one that is true without a card reader.

notes: Authored against the recipe, not against upstream's demo copy. Upstream ships no copy for this card at all, which is exactly why it has to be written from the recipe.

Duration is 126f and is not negotiable downstream: the two time windows in the recipe are contiguous at 0.551/0.55, so shortening the render desynchronises the entrance from the fan-out rather than trimming it.
